title: The Last Name
text: A family line has gone out: no embryos left in the bank, and no one living. The colonists want to mark it somehow.

choices.label: Carve the names
choices.reply: A plate by the Core with every name the line ever had. People stop to read it on their way to work.

choices.label: Keep working
choices.reply: We note it in the log. The colonists note that we noted it.
